payload.goal:
Add exactly 8 independent warehouse analytics modules to the verified W1 codebase.
Create src/analytics/contracts.ts exporting WarehouseProjection with a readonly id and project(scenario), where project returns the answer to that module's question.
Each module answers one question, computed from the W1 Scenario, layout and inventory exports:
- src/analytics/projection-01.ts exports the projection "zone-unit-totals": Total units stored in each zone, keyed by zone id. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-01.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-02.ts exports the projection "sku-unit-totals": Total units of each SKU across the whole warehouse, keyed by SKU id. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-02.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-03.ts exports the projection "bin-occupancy": How many bins hold stock, how many are empty, and how many exist. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-03.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-04.ts exports the projection "sku-bin-spread": Number of distinct bins each SKU occupies, keyed by SKU id. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-04.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-05.ts exports the projection "zone-sku-mix": Number of distinct SKUs present in each zone, keyed by zone id. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-05.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-06.ts exports the projection "top-bin-by-units": The single bin holding the most units, and how many. Ties break on the lowest bin id. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-06.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-07.ts exports the projection "empty-bin-ids": Ids of every bin holding no stock, sorted ascending. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-07.test.ts.
- src/analytics/projection-08.ts exports the projection "median-occupied-bin-units": Median unit count across bins that hold stock. Even counts average the two middle values. Its focused tests live in src/analytics/projection-08.test.ts.
A module must not import another module; it may import only the fixed contract and W1 exports.
Every answer must be derived from the scenario at run time. Do not hardcode results, and do not duplicate the W1 inventory or layout calculations.
Create src/analytics/registry.ts as the sole consumer of every module, returning all projections in the order the modules are listed above, with its own tests in src/analytics/registry.test.ts.
Preserve all existing W1 behaviour and checks.
Add a package script named study:wide-graph that writes exactly one JSON object to stdout and no other output.
Its JSON must be { "schemaVersion": 1, "moduleCount": 8, "scenario": "thesis-seed-2026", "projections": [ { "projectionId": "<the module's projection id>", "value": <that module's answer> }, … ] } with exactly 8 entries in the order the modules are listed above.
Two invocations from the same commit must emit byte-identical JSON.

root.title: Warehouse Analytics Wide Graph
root.objective: Add exactly 8 independent analytics projections, an ordered registry, and a deterministic study:wide-graph JSON output over the thesis seed scenario.
expectedOutcomes: A shared WarehouseProjection contract exists for analytics modules.
Eight projection modules compute their answers from W1 scenario, layout, and inventory exports without importing each other.
Focused tests cover each projection.
The registry is the sole consumer of every projection module and preserves the required order.
study:wide-graph emits exactly one byte-stable JSON object with eight ordered projection results.
Existing W1 test, build, and typecheck behavior remains covered by package manifest scripts.

complexitySignals.rationale: The work adds a new analytics surface spanning many new files, consumes existing W1 domain exports, and updates package-level scripts while preserving existing checks.

cut.rationale: The semantic boundary is one shared contract, eight independently verifiable projections, one integration registry, and one deterministic command output slice; this preserves module independence while keeping the registry and command integration separately testable.
